description: Angular service class 'WidgetTypesTableConfigResolver' that configures and manages a table of widget types, including actions like add, import, export, and view details, with dependencies on Angular components, services, and models.

classes.name: WidgetTypesTableConfigResolver
classes.description: Angular injectable service that provides configuration for a widget types table, including data fetching, actions, and permissions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for widget types, setting up fetch function and permissions based on user authority.

methods.name: isWidgetTypeEditable
methods.description: Determines if a widget type can be edited based on user authority and tenant ID.

methods.name: addWidgetType
methods.description: Opens a dialog to add a new widget type and navigates to its detail page upon selection.

methods.name: importWidgetType
methods.description: Imports a widget type via the import-export service and refreshes data.

methods.name: openWidgetEditor
methods.description: Navigates to the widget type editing page.

methods.name: openWidgetTypeDetails
methods.description: Opens the widget type details view.

methods.name: onWidgetTypeAction
methods.description: Handles actions (edit, openDetails, export) on widget types.
